svg.text: ZamMove — Hauling and Self-Drive Rental System
Zamboanga City · Software Engineering project · system overview
Roles: customer · driver · vehicle owner · cashier · admin

g.text: Three tiers: browser screens → Node.js API that holds every business rule → Supabase Postgres
frontend/customer · one app with a workspace per role:
Keeps the login token per browser tab
Sends actions, receives the user’s view
Stores no business data in the browser
Checks the signed login token on every request
auth · bookings · verification · rentals · workspace · finance
Pricing, capacity, driver eligibility, payments, PINs,
Each user receives only what their role may see
One action at a time · only changed rows saved · rollback on
14 tables · full record in JSONB plus
Row Level Security on: public keys
SMS & email (codes shown on screen today)
One status order shared by the customer, driver, admin screens and the server
Allowed from Pending, No driver found, Accepted, On the Way to Pickup and
Free before a driver accepts; 10% fee afterwards (recorded as a payment
PINs: 6 digits, expire in 30 min, 5 wrong tries lock for 5 min; the admin can
Payments: a customer GCash proof counts only when the driver records it; each
One account can hold several roles (for example an Owner-Driver). Staff roles are appointed by the owner admin.
Customers, drivers, owners and cashiers use the web app (frontend/customer); staff can also use the separate Admin Panel (frontend/admin).
Every table: id, data (JSONB full record), created_at, updated_at, plus the indexed columns shown. RLS on; only the backend can access.
Lines show the main references (arrows in the column lists). Links are checked by the backend rules; the full record of each row is the JSONB data column.
